title_display: South Wind, Clear Sky (from Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji)

to_work.title_display: Woman with a Parasol - Madame Monet and Her Son

work_relations.note: Like many Impressionists, Monet was influenced by Japanese ukiyo-e prints. The low horizon line, emphasis on atmosphere, and capturing of a specific moment in nature echo compositional and thematic elements found in works by artists like Hokusai.

places.connection: Katsushika Hokusai was born in the Katsushika district, which is now part of Sumida, Tokyo.
Katsushika Hokusai created the Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji series, including South Wind, Clear Sky, while living in Edo.
The Hokusai Museum in Obuse is dedicated to the artist and displays many of his works.
The British Museum holds a collection of Hokusai's works, including pieces from the Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji series.
Mount Fuji is the central subject depicted in the artwork South Wind, Clear Sky.
